text: In LA County, you can vote in person days before Election Day, at any vote center in the county.
seenIn: a classmate who says you have one polling place

room.label: students (demo crowd)
room.note: No published poll has measured this belief yet. The 5C pilot survey replaces this split with real student answers.

truthSource.label: LA County Registrar-Recorder/County Clerk: Voting In-Person
truthSource.oneLine: For the Nov 3, 2026 election, LA County vote centers open Saturday, Oct 24, and any county voter can use any of them through Election Day.

lesson.pattern: Assumed it works like back home
lesson.tip: One assigned polling place on one Tuesday is how many places work, not how LA County works. For where and when, go to the county registrar (lavote.gov), not memory.
